blocks.html: Reports stored on the TAK Server can be searched, filtered and visualized.

slides.title: Filter & sort reports
slides.html: Select the Filter icon to limit the list by current map view, date range, report type, status, importance or user callsign; Clear Filters shows everything again. Select Sort to order the list by Date, User Callsign, Importance, Status, Title or Type — click a choice again to reverse it.

slides.title: Build a reports dashboard
slides.html: Open Dashboard from the toolbar and filter down to the reports you want. Select Create New Chart, choose how to group it (Importance, Scale, Status, Type or User Callsign) and a pie or bar chart, then Create. Multiple charts can run side by side, each with its own filters.
